messages:
sara: kicking off a staged rollout now — pinwheel traffic split, target 15% (eu-west-1 primary), version v2.3.0. change window still open.
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v2.3.0 -> 15% traffic (eu-west-1). Release notes: https://redwood/release/2.3.0. Canary group: eu-west-1a. monitor: /dash/rollouts/3954123456
ops-bot: metric alert: p95 latency +12% vs baseline in eu-west-1 (since 3954123470), error rate 0.8% (baseline 0.12%). Spike correlated with new model variant.
mike: seeing a couple 502 spikes and transient kvcache OOM logs on host gpu-eu-03. frequency small but correlated with requests to v2.3.0.
alex: hold please. pausing the traffic shift now until we triage. pin fallback to v2.2.9 for eu-west-1.
sara: ack, pausing. @deploy-bot please pin routing to v2.2.9 for eu-west-1 and halt further progressive increases.
deploy-bot: action taken: traffic shift paused at 15%. routing pinned: eu-west-1 -> v2.2.9 for 100% fallback; canary halted. Audit: /audit/3954123456
mike: runbook check — rollback path validated earlier, cold start for v2.2.9 warmup ~30s. Suggest explicit rollback for eu-west-1 only (keep global hosted steady).
olivia: +1 to targeted rollback. Notify EU customers via status page and flag for SRE oncall. I can draft the notes.
alex: propose rollback cmd: `/deploy rollback --region eu-west-1 --to v2.2.9 --grace 30s` — will avoid global blast radius.
sara: go for rollback to eu-west-1. do not change other regions. After rollback, run 10% smoke test then re-evaluate telemetry for 30m.
ops-bot: incident created INC-2026-045 (staged-rollout-eu-latency). Pager dispatched to oncall.
mike: executing rollback now.
deploy-bot: rollback started: region=eu-west-1, target=v2.2.9. progress: 0% -> 100% in 3 steps. logs: /deploy/logs/3954123456
deploy-bot: rollback complete. routing confirmed: eu-west-1 -> v2.2.9 (100%).
ops-bot: post-rollback metrics: p95 returned to baseline, error rate down to 0.14%. continuing 30m observation window.
sara: great. we'll keep the change window open and run a small postmortem. action items: 1) pinwheel split analysis, 2) add regression test for new kv-cache coldpath, 3) update release notes with rollback root cause. olivia will handle customer comms.
olivia: drafted status update and posted to status.redwood.ai. ping me for edits. :thumbsup:
alex: once green at 30m, recommend holding v2.3.0 behind a canary flag until kvcache fix merged.
sara: agreed. blocking re-release until kvcache regression resolved. closing thread after observation window.
